summary: Anthropic's AI for Science program grants free Claude API credits for high-impact scientific projects. The Help Center (updated Mar 16, 2026) focuses selection on researchers attached to research institutions, including academia and nonprofits, and says successful applicants receive up to $20,000 in API credits for 6 months. Anthropic's Aug 27, 2026 news post broadens the application scope: any researcher is eligible to apply for up to $50,000 in credits per project, without guaranteed acceptance. That announcement says biology and chemistry researchers remain limited to Opus-class models; Claude Fable models continue to block professional biology and drug-development queries because of dual-use risks. Credits are API-only (not Claude.ai). Applications are reviewed on the first Monday of each month. Distinct from the Claude Team plan for scientists seating promotion.
claim_steps: Create a Claude Console account if you do not already have one (API access; credits do not apply to Claude.ai).

Complete the AI for Science application with team and project details. The Help Center prioritizes institution-attached researchers; the Aug 27, 2026 announcement says any researcher may apply. Acceptance is not guaranteed.
Wait for the monthly review (first Monday of each month). Unapproved submissions do not receive individual replies.
If approved, API credits are applied to the organization ID for the stated period. Multi-lab programs should apply on one account.
